overview: World-class Himalayan trekking website for Shail Hikers with real-time bookings, secure login, and online payments.
features: Internet Identity login with session persistence
Real-time seat availability tracking on all trek batches
Live booking system that reserves seats and confirms via payment
Stripe payment checkout with test mode and retry logic
Booking cancellation with immediate Stripe refund
Dashboard showing upcoming, past, and cancelled bookings with status badges
Payment success and failure pages with clear user messaging
